connectors.name: Left castellated header (top view)
connectors.orderNote: No pin numbers; USB-C at top, so position 1 is the top pad (closest to USB).

connectors.name: Right castellated header (top view)
connectors.orderNote: No pin numbers; USB-C at top, so position 1 is the top pad (closest to USB).

connectors.name: Back SWD pads (2x2)
connectors.orderNote: No pin numbers; USB at top of this back view. 2x2 pad group read as two horizontal rows: position 1 at the left of the row nearest the USB/top edge, then alternating rows (1 CLK, 2 GND, 3 DIO, 4 RST).

connectors.name: Back pad column
connectors.orderNote: No pin numbers; USB at top of this back view, so position 1 is the top pad (closest to USB).

connectors.name: Back battery pads
connectors.orderNote: No pin numbers; USB at top, so position 1 is the top pad.

uncertain: debug-pads-img2: the 2x2 SWD pad group could equally be read as two vertical columns (CLK/GND, DIO/RST); row grouping and resulting position order are not settled by the image.
back-pads-img2 positions 8-9: only silkscreen 010/009 and a shared NFC callout are printed, no P0.xx name; labels use the silkscreen numbers.
notes: Image 1 is the top view, image 2 the back view. Labels use the printed P0.xx/P1.xx port names; silkscreen numbers first in functions, then callouts outward from the pin. LED callouts (P0.30 LED_GREEN, P0.06 LED_BLUE, P0.26 LED_RED), BAT-LED and the RST silkscreen near the USB on the top view are skipped as LED/button items. Unlabeled edge pads in the back view are the same castellated pads as image 1 and are not repeated. Battery pads are included because they carry BAT+/BAT- (B+/B-) labels.
